name: claude-video-editor
description: Edit any video by conversation — or generate one from nothing. Bundles four layers: video-use (transcript-driven cut/grade/subtitle engine), HeyGen HyperFrames (HTML+GSAP motion-graphics rendered with alpha), a motion-craft library, and generate-footage (AI keyframes, Wan 2.2 image-to-video clips, ElevenLabs v3 narration with audio tags). Drop footage in a folder and say 'edit this', or just describe the video and get final.mp4.
